models.geometry: 6x16 transport, with an independent 15-column by 7-row logical spatial grid. Nine regional layouts across two editions define 87 output slots.
models.frameTransport: Six SET-only 52-byte 03/0B rows. Activate custom mode once on entry; preserve the 20 FPS software budget.
models.keyMap: Eighteen pinned Product 672 regional UI definitions and its exact 00/86 getter select the physical region. Unknown regions retain unambiguous fallback bindings; ambiguous Fn addresses are not guessed.
models.readback: Independent built-in 0F/82, brightness and logo queries. Compact Wave is incomplete. No RGB frame getter is established.
models.restoration: Retains a complete built-in baseline and exact raw brightness. Owned RGB is intent, and recovery does not replay it.
gaps: KI890 MCU is available; its lighting descriptor/getter bindings have not been independently traced against the existing Synapse/upstream contract in this bounded pass.
No RGB frame readback is established.
